english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for low temperature and for feeling cold or uncomfortable from it.
This is the all-purpose choice for air, weather, or your body feeling uncomfortably cold.
Use this as the all-purpose everyday choice for cold or chilly weather and things that feel icy.
